Mobile Truck

Calvin Klein

Bad Bunny Campaign Launch

Pop Up Mob took Calvin Klein's viral Bad Bunny campaign off the screen and into Brickell City Centre with a mobile truck takeover, capturing the heat of the moment and bringing the campaign's confidence and edge into a space where fans could step inside and experience it for themselves.

Fashion & ApparelApril 2025Miami, Florida50% Experiential
The Story
Miami, FL

The truck operated as a compact retail environment, giving shoppers direct access to the campaign collection at peak momentum. Guests stepped inside to explore and purchase Calvin Klein staples, receive limited-edition oversized totes and Bad Bunny posters, and cool off with complimentary popsicles tailored to the Miami heat. A dedicated photo moment gave visitors the chance to recreate the campaign imagery themselves, stepping into the frame and translating the visuals into personal, shareable content. Set within one of Miami's busiest retail hubs, the activation bridged online attention with in-person interaction, turning campaign heat into product discovery and measurable store traffic.
